answer: A proof-of-burn registry mitigates Sybil attacks by requiring agents to provably destroy base tokens to register each operational address. When autonomous agents route environmental logistics across a river basin, cedar reserve, or marine inlet, an attacker must expend scarce, non-recoverable capital for every fabricated entity. However, this model creates an economic barrier that penalizes low-margin participants while failing to deter adversaries with asymmetric financial resources.
